name: Rauthy
description: Rust identity provider supporting OpenID Connect, OAuth 2, and passkeys. Native service with embedded Hiqlite storage; requires an HTTPS reverse proxy.

notes.text: Experimental testing script. Requires a public DNS hostname and an existing HTTPS reverse proxy on port 443; proxy and certificates are not installed.
Native service extracted from the official image. Debian arm64 and emulated amd64 installs/migrations passed; real AMD64 Proxmox testing is pending and real ARM64 host testing has not been performed.
Initial administrator credentials are generated randomly in /root/rauthy.creds inside the LXC. The optional administrator email changes the initial username.
